The '''Basteel system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Basteel/Legends|Basteel]].
